title: Active parent and child progress in Run Detail
description: Read-only. Select an authenticated gateway profile, an active run with recorded child progress, owned FARMSLOT_CHILD_PROOF_TAB, FARMSLOT_CHILD_PROOF_RUN_ID and FARMSLOT_CHILD_PROOF_OUTPUT. For model-free marker setup, operation-log-proof-fixture.mjs with CHILD_PROGRESS_PROOF=1 executes real mark/sub commands and retains their files. Browser login uses operation-log-proof, CLI uses worker-ack-cli. No UI state injection or ordinary worker-dispatch claim. Rerun with FARMSLOT_CHILD_PROOF_EXPECT_READ_STATE=saved after stopping the owned fixture, or =error after making its checklist unreadable. Assert real disconnected/read-failure rendering with no UI state writes.

two-level-progress.intent: Show the current recorded child under its parent with separate real counts at wide and narrow widths.
